CLAIM-CEILING DEFECT (INTERPRETATION, material): report.md ('the tie-break confound is closed; the failure travels with the mechanism, not the calibration rule'; 'no further Jaccard-1NN blind work without a new mechanism class') exceeds what the evidence establishes. Auditor recomputation over ALL nine SELECT-feasible taus shows exactly one (0.3333) passes the AXIS-G3-NEW reincluded gate (FA 0.10/COV 0.925/UP_excl 0.8571), matching the parent audit's published select_feasible_and_g3_gate_met=[0.3333]. The max-slack higher-tau rule is a member of the rule family that systematically selects the most abstention-heavy feasible tau (FA non-increasing in tau => argmin-FA ties at the top of the feasible list => tau*=0.6 by construction); its failure (coverage/UP collapse) is a property of that rule, not proof that no SELECT rule can produce gate survival. This directly contradicts parent handoff do_not_assume[0]'s boundary and the producer's own result.json#unresolved[0]. producer_claim_supported=false on the stated ceiling; the frozen decision itself stands.

DESIGN-IDENTIFIABILITY DEFECT / INFORMATION GAIN ~0 (DERIVED, material): the frozen design_review.json#checks.decision_rule_reachability proves tau* deterministically equals the highest SELECT-feasible tau (0.6) and != 0.3333, while the parent audit it cites already published that among the SELECT-feasible set only 0.3333 passes the G3 reincluded gate. Therefore BLIND_FAILS@0.6 was a logical consequence of accepted evidence at freeze time; in a valid transaction (drift => MEASUREMENT_INVALID via continuity tripwires) BLIND_SURVIVES was unreachable. design_review's claim that 'accepted evidence does not exclude either configuration' is internally inconsistent with its own deterministic-emission argument plus the cited parent post hoc. The run legitimately produced new raw artifacts (full SELECT per-tau vectors at the 7 previously unpublished taus, reproduced controls), but its outcome is a validity reproduction of a known implication, not a new discriminating test of the director-mandate question. Producer disclosure of post-hoc knowledge (prereg §8.9, result.json#validity_notes) is honest but understates the entailment.
